newsitem.title: INDIA: Oil producers, consumers to meet in S.Africa in 97.
newsitem.headline: Oil producers, consumers to meet in S.Africa in 97.

text.p: The next meeting of world oil producing and consuming nations will be held in South Africa in 1997, a member of this year's host delegation India said on Sunday.
The meeting will be the sixth between oil importing and exporting nations since the dialogues began in the wake of the Gulf War oil price scare. Further details on the conference were not available.
Producers and consumers were wrapping up the last day of talks in this tourist resort state on Sunday.
Discussions so far have centred on security of energy supplies, the importance of stable prices, investment requirements and ways to meet the growing energy needs of emerging economies.
Delegates have also floated the idea of using the forums to develop a global energy organisation to collect data and possibly ideas for more unified world energy policies.
